beats_json.description: JSON array. Use numeric at/to in ORIGINAL source seconds, never final-edit seconds. Both endpoints must belong to kept source intervals. Overlays may span cuts in edit order; cutout/panel/behind must fit inside ONE kept interval. Use only supported types.

captions_json.description: Valid JSON object of caption options.

zoom_json.description: Valid JSON object of zoom options.

music_json.description: The literal string null to keep current music, or a valid JSON object. Never an empty string.
